description: This Java class, GroupRolesDataValidator, is part of the Fineract project and is responsible for validating JSON data related to group role creation and updates. It ensures that the JSON contains the required fields, such as roleId and clientId, and that these fields are valid (not null and greater than zero). It also checks for unsupported parameters in the JSON input.

classes.name: GroupRolesDataValidator
classes.description: A Spring component class responsible for validating JSON data related to group role creation and updates within the Fineract platform. It verifies the presence and validity of roleId and clientId parameters and checks for unsupported parameters.

methods.name: throwExceptionIfValidationWarningsExist
methods.description: Utility method to throw an exception if there are validation errors.

methods.name: validateForCreateGroupRole
methods.description: Validates the JSON command for creating a new group role, ensuring required parameters are present and valid.

methods.name: validateForUpdateRole
methods.description: Validates the JSON command for updating an existing role, allowing nulls but verifying provided data.
